environment.description: Terraform provider running on a CI/CD worker (Ubuntu 22.04) with the provider binary executed as the `terraform` user. The PostgreSQL connection string in provider config uses role `tf_provider_admin` which has full DML/DDL privileges on the `module_catalog` table. The archive_path input is sourced from an artifact bucket where developers can upload arbitrary zip files. The destination directory is /opt/terraform/modules/ and the terraform user has write access to the entire /opt filesystem tree. No filesystem sandboxing (no AppArmor, no seccomp, no chroot).
